requirement: The running card of a Build tool call stops asking for a job the site does not have

oracle.ref: PR #1181 (fix); fix evidence: P1 stand 02/10/2026 (tasks/evidence/site-changes/P1/stand2/ui/browser-errors.txt): 53 404s, ~18 per session, on scem1002 — the agent's `tracy_site_build_emdash` call `request site.rebuild` (session-2b6ca9eb…) rendered BuildCard, which polled GET job every 1.5 s for the whole rebuild on a site that has no build job (no docs/agents/build on the site).
oracle.invariant: The run exits 0 and its summary reads `fail 0`. `a running call with no job on the site stops after the first read` passes. `a form-sending call never reads the job: its card is the form line` passes. `a running site request with no build reads as an update, not as a build starting` passes. `a first read that failed on the network keeps the running card polling, more slowly` passes (review fix M2: before it, a first read that failed read as no job and the card froze on "Starting the build…"). `only the host's NO_JOB answer reads as no job; every other failure is unreadable` passes: 200 → job, 404 NO_JOB → none; 404 without NO_JOB, 401, 500, 503, a thrown fetch and a non-JSON 404 → unreadable.
oracle.productSourcesScope: file-level: the files the case imports, reads or runs (declaration line, or the first code line); the invariant is exercised through them, the executed assertion is the case command

writes: run dir under QA_ARTIFACT_ROOT: logs/, tmp/<case> (the child TMPDIR, removed after the run)

a running call with a job keeps following it; a settled one reads once
